lifecycle_steps.name: daemon_first_boot_provisioning
lifecycle_steps.details: Generated fresh QuantumNodeIdentity (ML-DSA-87 + ML-KEM-1024), requested 256-bit DEK wrap from live AWS KMS, saved envelope to disk.

lifecycle_steps.name: disk_state_zero_plaintext_leakage
lifecycle_steps.details: Verified on-disk envelope file contains only ciphertext and wrapped DEK (184 bytes). Zero occurrences of private keys in storage.

lifecycle_steps.name: operational_ml_dsa_87_signing_boot1
lifecycle_steps.details: Signed financial settlement payload (REC-AWS-KMS-001). Generated valid 4,627-byte signature verified against public key.

lifecycle_steps.name: daemon_shutdown_memory_zeroization
lifecycle_steps.details: Dropped in-memory handles. Memory buffers zeroized on drop.

lifecycle_steps.name: daemon_restart_cold_recovery_via_aws_kms
lifecycle_steps.details: Daemon restarted cold from disk. Sent wrapped DEK to AWS KMS Decrypt API in eu-north-1. Recovered keys in memory. Fingerprint matched original exactly.

lifecycle_steps.name: operational_ml_dsa_87_signing_boot2
lifecycle_steps.details: Signed subsequent financial settlement payload (REC-AWS-KMS-002) with restored in-memory key. 4,627-byte signature verified.

lifecycle_steps.name: negative_tampered_ciphertext_fail_closed
lifecycle_steps.details: Mutated 1 byte in envelope ciphertext. Daemon boot failed closed and refused to start.
